stdout: Fault localization complete. `services.Presence` lacks UpdateRemoteCluster; local PresenceService only has CreateRemoteCluster, so status changes have no persistence path. AuthServer.updateRemoteClusterStatus (lib/auth/trustedcluster.go) recalculates status on each read and replaces last heartbeat with the latest currently surviving tunnel; no tunnel leaves the originally stored zero heartbeat. This also lets deletion of the newest tunnel regress the timestamp. Likely fix points: add interface method; implement backend Put under remoteClusters/<name> with JSON and rc.Expiry(); in auth status refresh compare latest tunnel heartbeat to stored heartbeat before updating, persist changed status/heartbeat, and keep heartbeat when no tunnels. Existing local suite CRUD tests cover create/read/delete but not update or tunnel transition behavior. Caveat: TunnelConnectionStatus uses heartbeat freshness threshold, so 'active' should be clarified against this existing rule. No project source or tests modified.
